'''Viktor Rafaelyevich Dolnik''' ({{langx|ru|Ви́ктор Рафаэ́льевич До́льник}}; 13 January 1938 – 4 November 2013) was a [[Russians|Russian]] [[ornithology|ornithologist]]<ref>{{Cite journal | jstor=1366146 | last1=Dolnik | first1=Victor R. | last2=Blyumental | first2=Tatyana I. | title=Autumnal Premigratory and Migratory Periods in the Chaffinch (Fringilla coelebs coelebs) and Some Other Temperate-Zone Passerine Birds | journal=The Condor | year=1967 | volume=69 | issue=5 | pages=435–468 | doi=10.2307/1366146 }}</ref> who administered the [[Rybachy Biological Station]] for 22 years (from 1967 until 1989). ''[[Haemoproteus]] dolniki'' is named after him.<ref name="Valkiūnas2005">{{cite book|last=Valkiūnas|first=Gediminas|title=Avian malaria parasites and other haemosporidia|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=2btzeZON0qgC&pg=PA544|access-date=11 April 2011|year=2005|publisher=CRC Press|isbn=978-0-415-30097-1|page=544}}</ref>

==Biography==
Dolnik was born in [[Yekaterinburg|Sverdlovsk]] in 1938.<ref name="BakloushinskayaMinter2001">{{cite book |editor-last1=Bakloushinskaya |editor-first1=Irina Yu |editor-last2=Minter |editor-first2=D. W. |title=Vorontsov's who's who in biodiversity sciences: in Azerbaijan, Armenia, Belarus, Estonia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Russia, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Uzbekistan|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=GlTwAAAAMAAJ|access-date=11 April 2011|year=2001|publisher=KMK Scientific Press|page=114|isbn=9785873170920 }}</ref> In 1960, he graduated from Leningrad State University. For thirty years, he was the chief of the ornithological station "Rybachy" (literally "Fishers'" - after the village where it was situated). He gained a [[Candidate of Science]] degree in 1967, and the [[Doctor of Science]] in 1976. He became a professor in 1983.

Dolnik was chief research fellow at Zoological institute of Russian Academy of science. He was the vice-president of the Russian ornithologists' Union, an honorary member of the American ornithological union, and a corresponding member of German and Dutch ornithological unions. He was a recipient of the [[Medal "For Distinguished Labour"]] and the [[Medal "Veteran of Labour"]].

He died on 4 November 2013.<ref>[http://www.rbcu.ru/news/25629/ Кончина Виктора Рафаэльевича Дольника] {{in lang|ru}}</ref>

==Works==
Dolnik has about two hundred written works. Together with M.A. Kozlov, he was the author of a textbook on zoology for secondary schools. He was best known to the general public for a series of articles concerning human [[ethology]] (1980-1990s). These articles later were compiled into a book "[[Disobedient Child of Biosphere]]" (1994).
